summary: holaOS publishes no quantitative claims in its README; the only measured results are internal engineering notes on per-turn init latency (e.g. fixed init 2,492 -> 1,251 ms), one of which is backed by a committed 13-turn raw telemetry log, all from a single machine with no benchmark script. A runnable memory-eval harness with scenario fixtures exists, but no results from it are committed.
